acceptance: A merged PR bumps the catalog `rev` in deployment/global/skill-sync.conf to the PR #118 merge commit and selects retro and writing-for-agents; tests/test_skill_sync_conf.py passes in CI.
~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf matches the merged template except for intentionally local values, and `diff` between them shows no unexplained difference.
`tools/skill-sync apply`, `verify` and `check` against the live config all succeed.
retro and writing-for-agents exist in ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills and ~/.agents/skills, and each target's skill-sync.manifest lists them.
The previous unmanaged copies were saved to a dated backup directory outside the loader folders before being replaced; the backup path is reported.
`tools/skill-sync preview` was read before apply and showed only the two additions plus the changes the new rev implies; nothing was removed unexpectedly.
context: Batch: skillspector-remediation (serial mode; this repository names no prepared-delivery policy). All catalog work lands on branch chore/retire-tidy-perms, worktree ~/Developer/skill-sync-skills.wt-retire-tidy-perms, in the one final PR #118. Owner decisions (2026-11-13) are recorded in ~/.agents/handoffs/skill-sync-skills-skillspector-remediation-20261113.md. This item closes when its own pin-bump PR has merged and the live apply is verified. Guardrails: never `git add -A`; stage explicit paths. Commit as the human author in ~/.gitconfig, no agent co-author trailer. No push to main and no history rewrite. Do not reword skill prose to dodge a keyword rule. Do not touch files outside this item's scope; report adjacent issues instead. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before each commit; a failure blocks the commit. Decision gates: (1) If preview shows any removal or any change outside the two new skills and the files the rev bump implies, stop and report before apply. (2) If skill-sync refuses the unmanaged directories, move them to ~/.skill-sync-deployment/backups/<date>/ (never delete), then apply. (3) The live config's catalog rev is currently 24693de, ahead of the template's cdb35df at the time of the first scan; reconcile to the new merge commit, and if the live file has other local differences, keep them and report them. Guardrails: never touch ~/.claude/skills/synced or ~/.codex/skills/.system; never point the config at an authoring worktree; `rev` must be a full SHA present in ~/Developer/skill-sync-skills (fetch main there first, without disturbing local changes).
description: The deployment template pins an existing catalog commit, so it cannot select retro and writing-for-agents in the same PR that adds them. After PR #118 merges, a second small PR adds both `skill =` lines to deployment/global/skill-sync.conf and bumps `rev` to the merge commit (this repository's established 'pin the global catalog' pattern). Then the live config ~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf takes the same change and apply/verify/check run, so all three loader folders get the catalog copies. ~/.claude/skills currently holds unmanaged copies of both skills from `npx skills add`; skill-sync may refuse to overwrite a directory it does not own.
